spatialDiffuse.scope: One smooth world-position/world-normal diffuse-only approximation; not GI. No screen-coordinate light, specular change, texture or new asset.

sceneOcclusion.low: No added geometry buffer or SSAO passes; existing Low lighting retained
sceneOcclusion.limits: Screen-space depth/normal approximation, not complete indirect-light occlusion or GI. Final color multiplication also affects direct/specular response; hidden geometry and screen-edge limitations require actual normal/oblique review. No baked stock shadows or screen-fixed image.

sceneWindow.limits: C47 rotates only the C46 light direction/elevation around the unchanged window target at fixed source distance. All candela/cone/range/fill/exposure/softness/AO/assets/reflection unchanged. Explicit authoring comparison, no default or target acceptance.

shadowTelemetry.meaning: Caster source/target sampled inside the first shadow-mesh pre-draw; stock IDs captured after WebGL draw dispatch in the same render ID. Not a GPU fence, physical FPS or universal-frame acceptance.
